reason: I already keep a spreadsheet of my spending and it works, so I do not see why I would switch. The slip capture sounds handy, but I would have to set up an iPhone Shortcut and trust it with my bank slips before I know it saves me any real time.
objection: Setting up a Shortcut and a new app for something my spreadsheet already does. I do not want to spend an evening fixing a setup that breaks, and I am not sure the trial is long enough to show it saves time.
would_change_my_mind: If the Shortcut setup took a couple of minutes and it reliably turned my slips into entries without me retyping anything, I would keep the paid part after the trial.
